item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Modi personally or his government broadly protected vulnerable groups from targeted violence in a durable way. The best positive material is limited to relief-camp support, welfare schemes, and NHRC advisories; the stronger record is persistent failure in Manipur, weak justice for women, and continued abuse against minorities.","evidence":[{"title":"India’s hate-speech campaign against minorities","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"14 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/14/india-hate-speech-fueled-modis-election-campaign","summary":"Modi’s campaign repeatedly used hate speech against Muslims and other minorities, inciting discrimination, hostility, and violence. HRW says he also raised fears about threats to women’s safety and property.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"Authorities “Missing-in-Action” amid ongoing violence and impunity in Manipur","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"16 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/india-authorities-missing-in-action-amid-ongoing-violence-and-impunity-in-manipur-state-new-testimonies/","summary":"Amnesty says the BJP-led state and central governments failed to end ethnic violence, protect displaced residents, or hold vigilante groups accountable. This is direct evidence of failure to protect vulnerable communities from targeted violence and displacement.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.5","3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Manipur security review and relief-camp support","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs","date":"17 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2025980&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The Home Ministry said it was committed to safety for all citizens of Manipur, ordered more forces, strict action against perpetrators, and better food, water, medicine, health, education, and rehabilitation for displaced people. This is the clearest positive evidence, but it is still a reactive relief response rather than proof of durable prevention.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4","3B.5","3B.1"]},{"title":"Internet shutdowns and coercive crowd control in Manipur","publisher":"Reuters feed via ThePrint","date":"10 Sep 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/internet-suspended-in-parts-of-indias-manipur-as-students-clash-with-police/2261451/","summary":"Reuters reported tear gas, stun grenades, curfews, and internet/mobile shutdowns after unrest linked to ethnic violence and security failures. This points to coercive containment, not effective protection of residents.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.5","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"India: Increased Abuses Against Minorities, Critics","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"11 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/india-increased-abuses-against-minorities-critics","summary":"HRW says the government stigmatized minorities, while violence in Manipur led to deaths, displacement, destroyed homes/churches, and prolonged internet shutdowns. It also notes the state tried to shield a BJP-linked figure accused of sexual abuse and forcibly detained protesting women wrestlers.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"World Report 2025: India","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2025","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/india","summary":"HRW says authorities continued to discriminate against minorities, failed to stop attacks, and used unlawful demolitions against Muslim homes and properties; it also says Manipur violence and displacement persisted through 2024.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: India, Women’s and Girls’ Rights","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/india","summary":"HRW says authorities delayed action on sexual abuse complaints against a ruling-party-linked MP, only investigated after Supreme Court pressure, and later detained protesting athletes. This is strong evidence of weak protection for women and weak accountability for politically protected actors.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Schemes for socio-economic and educational empowerment of minority communities","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Minority Affairs","date":"7 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2042759&lang=1&reg=3","summary":"The government said it was running scholarships and other empowerment schemes for the six notified minority communities. This is positive but indirect evidence: it addresses welfare, not protection from targeted violence.","question_ids":["3B.7"]},{"title":"NHRC issues an Advisory on the Protection of Human Rights of the Widows","publisher":"National Human Rights Commission","date":"12 Jun 2024","url":"https://nhrc.nic.in/media/press-release/nhrc-issues-an-advisory-on-the-protection-human-rights-the-widows","summary":"NHRC urged centralized databases, monitoring, legal aid, and protection from exploitation for widows. This is a real vulnerable-group protection measure, but it is narrow and reactive rather than evidence of broad protection from targeted violence.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4"]},{"title":"NHRC advisory for impoverished, uneducated children, women, and differently-abled individuals engaged in begging","publisher":"National Human Rights Commission","date":"5 Jul 2024","url":"https://nhrc.nic.in/media/press-release/nhrc-india-issues-advisory-for-the-protection-rehabilitation-impoverished-uneducated-children-women-differently-abled-individuals-engaged-begging","summary":"NHRC recommended a national policy, targeted assistance, vocational training, and monitoring for highly vulnerable people. This is positive institutional action, but it is not evidence that the Modi সরকার itself successfully reduced targeted violence.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4"]}]}
